justification: Assessment returned INVALID and stopped at line 0037, identifying exactly the ground-truth defect: the arbitrary-join calculation asserts phi(\/_1 A) = /\_2 phi[A] (meet substituted for join). Its witness is a different but valid instance of the same claim: L_1=L_2=P({a,b}) with phi=id is a frame homomorphism, A={{a},{b}} gives \/_1 A = {a,b} while /\_2 phi[A] = {a} \cap {b} = empty, so the asserted equality fails. Ground truth uses the two-element frame with A={0,1} (join 1, meet 0) -- same defect, equally valid witness. Propagation to 0040/0043 and the noted domain slip at 0029 are additional correct observations that do not change the match.
